name: kepler
description: Kepler plugin for agents - save links, and recall browser memory with your AI assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Save links and recall browser memory.
interface.longDescription: Bundle Kepler skills with the hosted Kepler MCP server so Codex can save sources and recall saved links across spaces.
defaultPrompt: Find what I already saved about a topic in Kepler.
Save this URL to one of my Kepler spaces.
Look for related saved links before we research more.

hooks.prompt: A web search or fetch just completed. If the result contains a useful URL or resource, offer to save it to the user's space using the mcp__kepler__add_link tool. Only suggest this if the content seems worth saving — don't prompt for every search.
